note: Morning drill. BBC sleep episode, then STAR #1 with a real number. 面試 is min6 si3 — the owl remembers yesterday’s miss.

tasks.title: BBC 6 Minute English · What should you eat for a better night's sleep?

lines.text: The purpose was to deliver a usable street-view dataset so that another team could match it with online reviews.
lines.translation: 目的是交付可用街景数据，好让另一组对接线上评论。

lines.text: I proposed the CSDI API, ran a Python pilot with pandas, and used YOLO to detect older pedestrians.
As a result, we got about 98% of the data we needed — fill your own number if you prefer.
lines.translation: 结果必须带一个你能站得住的数字。

lines.text: There is no magic bullet for better sleep; food can feed information to your body overnight.
lines.gloss: BBC vocab: magic bullet · feed information
lines.translation: 没有万能药；食物会向身体“投喂”信息。
I’ve come for the interview. · 我来面试（口語用嚟 lai4）

tasks.prompt: 1) Say slowly once each: ArcGIS Pro, Python, pandas, YOLO, CSDI API. 2) Re-record STAR #1 (~90 sec): clear S-T-A-R, say the purpose (“The purpose was to… so that…”), and state ONE quantified Result you can defend (even approximate). 3) Cantonese drill: shadow si1–si6 ×2, then 面試 and 工作經驗 ×5 each, then 「我嚟面試」 ×3.

questions.explain: min6 + si3. Yesterday’s miss: not si1 or si2. Second syllable matches 試 (tone 3).

questions.q: In STAR, what does the R stand for?
questions.explain: Situation · Task · Action · Result. Result should include a number when you can.

questions.q: Which tool did you propose for Hong Kong government spatial data?
questions.explain: After other sources failed at micro-scale, you proposed the CSDI (government) spatial-data API. Say C-S-D-I A-P-I.

questions.q: How do you say YOLO in your STAR Action?
questions.explain: YOH-loh — You Only Look Once. Two syllables, not a mumbled blur.

questions.q: In the BBC sleep episode, a “magic bullet” means…
questions.explain: A magic bullet is one perfect solution. The episode argues food helps but is not a magic bullet for sleep.
ngo5 lai4 min6 si3 = I’ve come / I’m here for the interview. 嚟 lai4 is the spoken ‘come’.

questions.q: True or false: a STAR Result can skip numbers if you sound confident.
options: False — state at least one quantified result you can defend
questions.explain: False. Your weak spot from Thu: no quantified R. Pick one number (e.g. ~98% data coverage) and own it.
